result.title: PRECOCIAL: Pretraining with Code Curriculums via Iterative Search for Accelerated Learning
result.summary: Fully synthetic pretraining data generated by symbolic programs can bootstrap downstream training on naturalistic tasks, such as language modeling, but the generating programs have so far been designed by hand. We introduce PRECOCIAL, a method for automatically optimizing programs that generate synthetic pretraining data. Starting from an initial generator program, an LLM iteratively rewrites the program, and each rewrite is scored by pretraining a randomly-initialized transformer on its data and fine-tuning it on the downstream task. Because every score requires training, PRECOCIAL keeps a single network for the entire search, continuing its pretraining for each accepted program instead of training a new network per candidate, making it significantly more efficient. On four language and code datasets, at a fixed fine-tuning budget, optimized programs reach lower perplexity than hand-designed curricula, published procedural generators, random program mutation and the program the LLM writes in the first iteration of the search, and reach the same perplexity as the hand-designed curricula with 9-33% fewer fine-tuning steps. PRECOCIAL also ends with lower perplexity than FunSearch and AlphaEvolve, which train a new network for every candidate, at the same number of evaluations and a lower cost. We also observe that an optimized program generator from one domain transfers to datasets in other domains. Additionally, optimized programs allow for better downstream performance on four different reasoning and problem-solving tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PRECOCIAL：让 LLM 迭代改写「生成合成预训练数据的程序」，并以在同一个网络上继续预训练再下游微调的得分作为搜索信号，从而自动优化数据课程；在语言与代码数据集上比手工课程和程序生成器更省微调步数，并观察到生成程序的跨域迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以下游训练结果作为数据/程序价值的评分信号」及单一网络复用评估成本的搜索方式，可能为 LVR 的训练数据课程设计、监督信号分配与跨任务迁移提供可核查的借鉴线索，但论文面向文本/代码预训练，与视觉推理状态的直接关联尚未验证。
